No specific product brands mentioned — description says 'high-quality products' but customers with sensitivities, allergies, or brand preferences need to know what will be used on their hair
No definition of what constitutes 'long or extra long hair' that triggers additional fees — customers cannot assess whether extra charges will apply to them (shoulder-length? waist-length?)
No cancellation or rescheduling policy stated — essential for appointment-based services; customers need to know flexibility if plans change
